# ionet-examples

Example collection for ionet (ioGame) - a Java-based game server framework (v25.3).

## Project Structure

```
ionet-examples/
├── ionet-quick-demo/          # Minimal server example with executable JAR
├── ionet-cookbook-code/       # Comprehensive examples (9 sub-modules)
│   ├── common-data/           # Shared data models, commands, error codes
│   ├── logic-hall/            # Player hall logic, requests, broadcasts
│   ├── logic-room/            # Game room logic
│   ├── logic-internal/        # Internal service communication
│   ├── external/              # WebSocket external connections
│   ├── gm/                    # Game management module
│   ├── example-ws-token/      # WebSocket token authentication example
│   ├── one-application/       # Aggregator module
│   └── one-client/            # Client for testing
├── ionet-spring-example/      # Spring Boot 4.0.0 integration
└── ionet-sdk-example/         # SDK code generation (C#/TypeScript/Godot)
```

## Build Commands

```bash
# Install all modules
mvn install

# Compile
mvn compile

# Package (creates JARs)
mvn clean package

# Run quick demo JAR
java --add-opens java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED -jar ionet-quick-demo/target/ionet-quick-demo.jar
```

## Architecture

Microservices-like architecture with separate logic servers communicating via Aeron IPC:

```
one-application (aggregator)
├── logic-hall      # Player hall, requests, broadcasts
├── logic-room      # Game room logic
├── logic-internal  # Internal service communication
└── external        # WebSocket external connections
```

## Key Patterns

### Action Controller
- `@ActionController` - Marks a class as an action controller
- `@ActionMethod` - Marks a method as an action handler
- `@VirtualThread` - Marks a method to run in virtual thread

### Command Classes
Separate command interfaces in `common-data` for different business domains:
- `HallCmd.java` - Hall-related commands (loginVerify, hello, internalOffline)
- `RoomCmd.java` - Room-related commands (createRoom, enterRoom, quitRoom, ready, operation)
- `BroadcastCmd.java` - Broadcast-related commands (broadcastUser, broadcastUsers, broadcastMulticast)
- `ErrorCodeCmd.java` - Error code example commands (index, throwsExample)
- `CallCmd.java` - Inter-server call commands
- `SendCmd.java` - Server-to-server send commands
- `RequestCmd.java` - Request/response pattern commands
- `InternalCmd.java` - Internal service communication commands
- `Jsr380Cmd.java` - Bean validation (JSR-380) commands
- `FlowContextCallCmd.java` - FlowContext-based call commands
- `FlowContextSendCmd.java` - FlowContext-based send commands
- `FlowContextBroadcastCmd.java` - FlowContext-based broadcast commands

### Broadcast
Server-initiated push notifications to clients:
- `broadcastUser` - Push to single user
- `broadcastUsers` - Push to multiple users
- `broadcastMulticast` - Push to all connected users

### FlowContext
Request context passing between servers, provides:
- `getUserId()` - Get current user ID
- `bindingUserId(long)` - Bind user ID to context
- Inter-server communication via `CommunicationKit`

## ionet-cookbook-code Detailed Examples

### common-data Module
Shared models and commands for all logic servers:

**Message Classes:**
- `UserMessage.java` - User information (id, nickname)
- `BookMessage.java` - Book data (bookName, authorName)
- `ErrorCode.java` - Error code enum implementing `ErrorInformation`
- `ErrorCodeMessage.java` - Test message for ErrorInformation methods
- `ErrorCodeThrowsMessage.java` - Test message for assertXxxThrows methods
- `PlayerMessage.java` - Player data
- `ReadyMessage.java` - Ready status message
- `EnterRoomMessage.java` - Room entry message
- `MyOperationCommandMessage.java` - Operation command message
- `MyOperationEnum.java` - Operation enum for room operations
- `ValidMessage.java` - Message for JSR-380 validation testing
- `EmailMethodEventMessage.java` - Email event message
- `EmailAnyMessage.java` - Any-type email message

**Command Interfaces:**
- `CmdModule.java` - Module command constants
- `HallCmd.java` - Hall commands (cmd=10)
- `RoomCmd.java` - Room commands (cmd=11) with broadcast commands
- `BroadcastCmd.java` - Broadcast commands (cmd=12)
- `CallCmd.java` - Inter-server call commands (cmd=20)
- `SendCmd.java` - Server send commands (cmd=21)
- `RequestCmd.java` - Request commands (cmd=22)
- `InternalCmd.java` - Internal communication commands (cmd=23)
- `Jsr380Cmd.java` - Validation commands (cmd=24)
- `ErrorCodeCmd.java` - Error code example commands (cmd=16)
- `FlowContextCallCmd.java` - FlowContext call commands (cmd=25)
- `FlowContextSendCmd.java` - FlowContext send commands (cmd=26)
- `FlowContextBroadcastCmd.java` - FlowContext broadcast commands (cmd=27)

**Extension/Utility Classes:**
- `UserKit.java` - User management utility (in-memory user storage)
- `VirtualThread.java` - Annotation for virtual thread execution
- `Hello.java` - Simple hello message

### logic-hall Module
Player hall actions handling user management, broadcasts, and inter-server communication:

**Actions:**
- `HallAction.java` - Hall actions:
  - `loginVerify` - User login verification with JWT
  - `hello` - Simple hello response
  - `internalOffline` - Handle user offline event
- `BroadcastAction.java` - All broadcast types:
  - `triggerBroadcastUser` - Broadcast to single user (empty, int, bool, long, string, object, lists)
  - `triggerBroadcastUsers` - Broadcast to multiple users (same types)
  - `triggerBroadcastMulticast` - Broadcast to all users (same types)
- `CallAction.java` - Inter-server call examples:
  - Call methods with various return types (empty, int, bool, long, string, object, lists)
- `SendAction.java` - Server-to-server send examples:
  - Send methods with various types
- `RequestAction.java` - Request/response pattern examples:
  - Request methods with various return types
- `ErrorCodeAction.java` - ErrorInformation interface examples:
  - `index` - Demonstrates getCode, getMessage, require, assertTrue, assertNonNull
  - `throwsExample` - Demonstrates assertTrueThrows, assertNullThrows
- `Jsr380Action.java` - JSR-380 bean validation:
  - `verifyData` - Validates message using bean validation annotations
- `FlowContextCallAction.java` - FlowContext-based calls:
  - Call methods using FlowContext
- `FlowContextSendAction.java` - FlowContext-based sends:
  - Send methods using FlowContext
- `FlowContextBroadcastAction.java` - FlowContext-based broadcasts:
  - Broadcast methods using FlowContext
- `PressureAction.java` - Pressure testing related actions
- `GameManagerAction.java` - Game management actions
- `AttachmentAction.java` - Attachment handling
- `OnExternalAction.java` - External connection actions

### logic-room Module
Game room logic with operation handlers:

**Actions:**
- `RoomAction.java` - Room management:
  - `createRoom` - Create a new game room
  - `enterRoom` - Join an existing room
  - `quitRoom` - Leave the current room
  - `ready` - Set player ready status
  - `operation` - Handle custom room operations
  - `listRoomId` - List all available room IDs

**Services:**
- `MyRoomService.java` - Room management service:
  - `createRoom()` - Create new room
  - `getRoom(long roomId)` - Get room by ID
  - `getRoomByUserId(long userId)` - Get room by user ID
  - `optionalRoomByUserId(long userId)` - Optional room lookup
  - `addRoom(Room room)` - Add room to management
  - `listRoom()` - List all rooms
  - `getUserOperationHandler(MyOperationEnum)` - Get operation handler

**Operation Handlers (operation/):**
- `EnterRoomOperationHandler.java` - Handle room entry
- `ReadyOperationHandler.java` - Handle ready status change
- Custom operation handlers implementing `OperationHandler`

**Data:**
- `InternalOperationEnum.java` - Internal operation enum
- Room-specific data models

### logic-internal Module
Internal service communication examples:
- Inter-server communication patterns
- Service discovery and invocation

### external Module
WebSocket external connection handling:
- `ExternalServer.java` - WebSocket server configuration
- Connection management and authentication

### gm Module
Game management features:
- Administrative actions
- Server monitoring and management

### example-ws-token Module
WebSocket token authentication example:
- JWT-based authentication
- Token verification and user binding

## Key Interfaces

### ErrorInformation
Implemented by error code enums. Provides validation and error handling methods:

```java
public interface ErrorInformation {
    int getCode();
    String getMessage();
    <T> T require(T value);
    void assertTrue(boolean condition);
    void assertTrueThrows(boolean condition);
    void assertNonNull(Object obj);
    void assertNullThrows(Object obj);
}
```

**Example Usage:**
```java
// Get error info
int code = ErrorCode.illegalOperation.getCode();
String msg = ErrorCode.illegalOperation.getMessage();

// Validate input
String name = ErrorCode.illegalOperation.require(message.name);

// Assert conditions
ErrorCode.loginFailed.assertTrue(success);
ErrorCode.roomNotExist.assertNonNull(room);

// Expected failure scenarios
ErrorCode.illegalOperation.assertTrueThrows(Objects.nonNull(roomByUserId));
ErrorCode.roomNotExist.assertNullThrows(room);
```

### Room Extension
Game room management with operation handlers:

```java
// Create and manage rooms
Room room = roomService.createRoom();
roomService.addRoom(room);

// Room operations
room.operation(InternalOperationEnum.enterRoom, flowContext);
room.operation(operationHandler, flowContext, command);
```

## Conventions

- **JVM Options**: Always use `--add-opens java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED --enable-native-access=ALL-UNNAMED` when running servers
- **SDK Method Names**: Use `@DocumentMethod` annotation to fix method names before SDK code generation
- **i18n**: Use `Locale.setDefault(Locale.US)` or `Locale.CHINA` for consistent behavior
- **Virtual Threads**: Use `@VirtualThread` annotation for blocking operations
